title: github fetch_issues_data
description: A pointer to one issue body, which the connector writes to the blob store at s3_key. The shared internal/descriptions IssueDescriptionPayload, also used by Jira, so the repository id is named platform_project_id. snake_case keys. An issue with an empty body emits no record.

s3_key.description: descriptions/{organizationId}/github/issues/{platform_repo_id}/{number}. The object is the raw Markdown body.
